programme.title: Shakespeare in Love

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.desc: Mae'r Blociau Lliw yn mwynhau dawnsio ond pa liwiau sy'n gwneud y partneriaid gorau? The Colourblocks enjoy a dance.

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Pan mae Tomos yn benthyg cloch lwcus Persi ar gyfer siwrne beryglus, dydi Tomos ddim yn ddigon gofalus ac mae'n colli'r gloch. Thomas borrows Percy's lucky bell for a dangerous delivery.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Mae cystadleuaeth y Trên Blodau yn cyd-fynd â noson arbennig Crugwen a Dai. Ond mae 'na broblem! The Flower Train competition coincides with Crugwen and Dai's night, but there is a problem.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae Cochyn yn chwarae gêm newydd mae wedi ei chreu ac mae Digbi'n awyddus iawn i greu gêm newydd hefyd. Cochyn is playing a new game he's invented. Digbi wishes he could invent a game too.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: As Harri tries to relax in the pool, he gets a call to say that the door to the changing room has broken. Wrth i Harri geisio ymlacio yn y pwll, mae'n cael galwad am rywbeth 'sdi torri.

programme.title: Egin Bach
programme.desc: Mae Mili ac Ato'n dod o hyd i genhinen pedr,ond mae rhywbeth wedi bwyta ei dail! MaeTera ac Ato'n blasu mwyar duon. Milli and Ato find a daffodil and Tera and Atto try some blackberries.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Blero'n diodde' o binnau bach yn ei draed, sy'n creu helynt yng nghystadleuaeth Sefyll yn Stond Ocido. Blero gets pins and needles and causes chaos at the musical statues competition.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Bochau wedi cael llond bol ar fwyta bresych, ac felly'n codi pac ac yn mynd ar ei wyliau i Fferm Ty Mawr. Bochau is fed up with eating cabbage all night and day and heads for the farm.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo have a magic xylophone that can freeze Dad in space and time. However, Dad gains control and freezes Bluey instead.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Ifor Hael sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! The challenge is to collect as many clean teeth as possible and win the Dani Dant Trophy!

programme.title: Timpo
programme.desc: Mae cyfaill Piws Po eisiau glanio ei hawyren ger y Pocadlys ond rhaid i'r tîm adeiladu llain glanio yn gyntaf. Piws Po's friend wants to land her aeroplane near HQ, but they need a runway.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae annwyd ar Cen Twyn felly mae'r Harbwr Feistr eisiau i bawb dynnu at ei gilydd i orffen eu gwaith yn gyflym i Cen gael gorffwys. Heti the Hovercract leads Twt astray when Cen has a cold.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamborî! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: While diving down to the Midnight Zone, the Octonauts are attacked by bomber worms.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Heddiw, disgyblion dewr Ysgol Glan Morfa yw'r mor ladron ifanc sy'n helpu Bendant a Cadi i wynebu tasgau Capten Cnec. Today, the brave pupils from Ysgol Glan Morfa are the young pirates who help Bendant and Cadi face Capten Cnec's challenges.

programme.title: Shwshaswyn
programme.desc: Beth sy'n digwydd ym myd Shwshaswyn heddiw? Heddiw, ymunwch gyda ni ar y traeth - rydym...

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Pan mae Eli'n codi moronen, mae hi'n siomedig ei bod yn gam. Ond a yw bod yn gam yn eu hatal rhag bod yn flasus? When Ellie digs up a carrot, she's disappointed to discover it's all wonky!

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Leisa a Betsan yn mynd ar antur i ddarganfod sut mae selsig yn cael eu gwneud gyda Hywel y ffermwr hud. Leisa and Betsan go on an adventure to find out how sausages are made with Hywel the magic farmer.

programme.title: Crawc a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae Toad yn comisiynu darlun o'i hun gan Mrs Dyfrgi ond ni all aros ddigon llonydd iddi ei baentio. Toad commissions a portrait of himself, but can't keep still for her to paint him.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cêt ar antur hudolus a chwareus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am Twrch yn y goedwig. Kim and Cêt go on a magical and playful adventure as they search for Twrch in the forest.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae Mymryn, Lleia a Macsen yn edrych ymlaen i gael tro gyda'u barcud triciau troi-a-throi yn yr ardd ond mae problem wrth i'r gwynt godi. The Wees fly a kite and end up causing some damage!

programme.title: Amser Maith Maith Yn Ol
programme.desc: Mae Tadcu yn darllen stori am Y Nadolig ac mae 'na gyffro mawr wrth i deulu Fferm Llwyn yr Eos baratoi at y Nadolig. There's excitement at Llwyn yr Eos as the family prepare for Christmas.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Rhaglen i blant lle da ni'n ymweld a gwledydd y byd i ddysgu am yr hanes, bryd, tirwedd, plant a'r diwylliant. Tro hwn: trip i Wlad yr Ia. We take trips around the world. This time: Iceland.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pan mae Pablo eisiau chwarae â phlant eraill yn y parc nid ydynt eisiau chwarae efo fo. Beth sy'n bod? Pablo wants to play with the children in the park, but they keep moving away.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Dyw Mari ddim yn fodlon i Mam rhoi dail bach yn y bwyd wrth iddi goginio felly mae Hywel y ffermwr hudol yn esbonio popeth am berlysiau iddi. When Mary doesn't want Mum to put little leaves in the food, Hywel the magical farmer explains about herbs.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r castell tywod gododd yr Whws ddoe wedi diflannu, mae nhw'n dysgu am y môr a'r llanw. The sandcastle which the Woohoos made yesterday has disappeared, they learn how this happens.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen yn gadael drws eu cartre' ar agor ar ddamwain yn ystod storm ac mae'n gorlifo. Guto Gwningen accidentally leaves the burrow's door open during a storm and it floods.

programme.title: Bendibwmbwls
programme.desc: Mae Ben Dant ar antur newydd i ailgylchu, i droi sbwriel yn sbeshal a gwastraff yn gampwaith. Ben Dant joins pupils from Ysgol Gynradd Llanfairpwllgwyngyll, to create a superb treasure.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: A penguin is missing at Pontypandy. Norman comes across him and takes him home. But due to a mistake, the Penguin ends up in the shop with Dilys rather than being safe at home with Norman and Mandy.

programme.title: Kim a Cai a Cranc
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cai ar antur hudolus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth, wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am gragen newydd i Cranc. Join Kim and Cai as they search for a new shell for Cranc.

programme.desc: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon puts pressure on Oscar Tully to raise up his bannermen

programme.title: House of the Dragon: The Queen Who Ever Was
programme.sub-title: The Queen Who Ever Was Season 2, Episode 8
programme.desc: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape and Rhaenyra looks to press home her advantage. Fantasy drama, starring Matt Smith and Emma D'Arcy

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Winter Is Coming
programme.desc: Lord Eddard Stark is torn between his family and an old friend when he is asked to serve at the side of King Robert Baratheon. However, neither man is aware that their country is on the verge of a bitter power struggle that could lead to its destruction. First episode of the fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series of novels, starring Sean Bean, Mark Addy, Lena Headey and Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Kingsroad
programme.desc: Bran clings to life as Ned prepares to head south with the king - only for the youngster to come under attack once more. Jon discovers a different side to Tyrion when he accompanies him on a journey to the Wall, while Daenerys becomes more assertive toward her new husband, the warlord Khal Drogo. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean, Mark Addy and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Lord Snow
programme.desc: Ned finally takes up his role at the side of the king, but struggles to deal with the political power games of Robert's cunning advisers. The weary lord is asked to organise a tournament, but finds the royal finances in a dire state - and his job is made even harder by troubling news from home. Meanwhile, Tyrion's visit to the Wall reveals the men of the Night's Watch are in desperate need of reinforcement, and relations between Daenerys and Viserys become increasingly strained. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Mark Addy

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Cripples, B****rds and Broken Things
programme.sub-title: Cripples, B****rds and Broken Things Season 1, Episode 4
programme.desc: Ned searches for the truth about Jon Arryn's death, but is far from certain he can trust Pycelle or Littlefinger. The balance of power between the exiled Targaryens shifts dramatically, Jon Snow befriends a vulnerable new recruit at the great Wall, and Bran's recovery is made more difficult by a series of disturbing dreams. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean, Aiden Gillen and Julian Glover

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Wolf and the Lion
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Lion Season 1, Episode 5
programme.desc: Ned tries to stop Robert from entering the tournament after a suspicious death threatens to overshadow the event - and the competition is plunged into chaos when one of the favourites suffers a surprise defeat. Meanwhile, Catelyn takes the captive Tyrion east in search of refuge at the Eyrie, home of her sister Lysa. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Mark Addy

programme.title: All Her Fault
programme.desc: Reeling from the home invasion, Marissa tries to learn the truth. As Peter comes clean, she must decide how to protect the family

programme.title: Fish Town
programme.desc: August arrives and the fishermen of Brixham spend time ashore with their families as their boats are repaired - but summer proves costly for Jan, who loses £1,000 for every day his vessel is out of action. Apprentice deckhand Logan has to decide whether a life at sea is the right choice for him and his family, and seafood seller Jenny receives a surprise on her 65th birthday

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming heads across the Irish Sea to Dublin, where he succumbs to the city's famous charm and meets some of its most fascinating characters. On a journey that takes in an 18th-century pleasure house and a burlesque life-painting class, Alan also stops off in Temple Bar for a pint with singer Sharon Corr, unlocks a mystery in Ireland's oldest library and uncovers a stylish secret that lurks behind the steel shutters of an old lock-up

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming visits Glasgow, one of his favourite cities, to reveal unusual and often hidden sights and sounds overlooked by the public. Starting at the Necropolis, he travels to the world's oldest music hall before enjoying the views from a city-centre landmark. He also finds the time to take tea with a film star

programme.title: Game of Thrones: A Golden Crown
programme.desc: Ned is reinstated by Robert and hears rumours that associates of the Lannisters have begun stirring up trouble across the Seven Kingdoms. Tyrion concocts a risky scheme to escape the Eyrie, Bran's first trip outside the castle since his accident nearly ends in tragedy, and Viserys causes uproar in Khal Drogo's home city. Drama, starring Sean Bean

programme.title: Game of Thrones: You Win or You Die
programme.sub-title: You Win or You Die Season 1, Episode 7
programme.desc: Lord Tywin readies his son Jaime for battle as House Lannister prepares for conflict, and Ned confronts Cersei about what he has learnt while investigating Jon Arryn's death. Meanwhile, at the Wall, Jon Snow waits to make his vows to the Night's Watch, and across the sea, Khal Drogo vows revenge on the Seven Kingdoms in response to the attempted assassination of Daenerys. Starring Charles Dance and Sean Bean

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Pointy End
programme.desc: Battle commences as the Lannisters launch their bid to seize the throne. Robb rounds up his allies as he prepares to confront Tywin's troops, while Tyrion forms an unlikely alliance with a savage tribe. At King's Landing, Arya and Syrio are forced to fight for their lives, and a sinister new enemy emerges at Castle Black. Meanwhile, Daenerys tries to reconcile her lust for power with the shocking brutality of war

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Baelor
programme.desc: Ned struggles to endure his imprisonment at the hands of the Lannisters, and faces a fateful decision to save Sansa's life - while Catelyn negotiates a deal with an unreliable ally. Tyrion's father forces him to take to the battlefield, Robb seeks to prove his mettle in combat, and Daenerys' power comes under threat as Drogo's condition worsens. Fantasy drama, starring Sean Bean and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Fire and Blood
programme.desc: Robb's bannermen make a declaration that threatens to throw Westeros into disarray. Catelyn confronts Jaime Lannister about Bran's near-fatal fall, Arya tries to flee the capital, and Tywin sends Tyrion on a surprising assignment. Jon Snow struggles to decide where his loyalties lie, and Daenerys tries to rebuild her life after a tragic event. Fantasy drama, starring Richard Madden and Michelle Fairley

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The North Remembers
programme.desc: The seven kingdoms of Westeros prepare for all-out war as newly crowned King in the North Robb Stark marches south to avenge his father. Tyrion Lannister arrives in King's Landing to curb the excesses of teenage tyrant Joffrey, and Stannis Baratheon, brother of the late King Robert, sets his sights on the Iron Throne. Fantasy drama based on George RR Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire novels, starring Stephen Dillane, Richard Madden, Peter Dinklage and Jack Gleeson

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Night Lands
programme.desc: Tyrion turns his anger on Cersei for alienating Joffrey's subjects in the wake of the capital's bloody purge, and Theon returns to the Iron Islands for first time in nine years, where he discovers his father Balon is planning to rebel against the crown once again. Arya shares a secret with her new friend Gendry while travelling north to the Wall, and Davos Seaworth recruits an ally who may prove useful in Stannis Baratheon's naval invasion of King's Landing

programme.title: Game of Thrones: What Is Dead May Never Die
programme.sub-title: What Is Dead May Never Die Season 2, Episode 3
programme.desc: Tyrion strengthens his position as Hand of the King with a risky gambit devised to identify the member of the small council in league with his sister Cersei, while at Winterfell, Maester Luwin tries to help Bran make sense of his dreams. Catelyn travels to the Stormlands to foster an alliance with the Baratheons, but King Renly, his new wife Margaery Tyrell and her brother Ser Loras have other plans. Fantasy drama, starring Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Garden of Bones
programme.desc: Robb Stark's chain of victories against the Lannisters enrages Joffrey, who punishes Sansa for her brother's successes. Tyrion struggles to find a way to curb his nephew's cruel excesses and enlists Cersei's lover Lancel as an informant. Catelyn urges the Baratheon brothers to forgo their ambitions and unite against a common enemy, while across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys and her exhausted retinue arrive at the walled city of Qarth

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Ghost of Harrenhal
programme.sub-title: The Ghost of Harrenhal Season 2, Episode 5
programme.desc: Catelyn is forced to flee when the Baratheon brothers' rivalry comes to a bloody end, and Lord Baelish spots an opportunity to further his own ambitions. Tyrion discovers Joffrey is planning to use a secret weapon to defend his seat of power, and Theon sails for the Stony Shore to prove his worth as a Greyjoy. Arya receives a favour from the man she freed from Harrenhal, and the Night's Watch arrives at the Fist of the First Men to stem the advance of the wildling army

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Old Gods and the New
programme.sub-title: The Old Gods and the New Season 2, Episode 6
programme.desc: King Joffrey's tyrannical rule prompts the people of King's Landing to riot, with near devastating consequences for Sansa. Meanwhile, beyond the Wall, Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself. and across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys' resolve strengthens as she vows to reclaim what she believes is rightfully hers. Fantasy drama, starring Emilia Clarke

programme.title: Game of Thrones: A Man Without Honour
programme.sub-title: A Man Without Honour Season 2, Episode 7
programme.desc: Theon's determination to prove his Ironborn status prompts him to embark on a hunt. Daenerys receives an invitation that could prove useful to her cause, and Jaime Lannister's fortunes appear to change after a meeting with a relative among Robb Stark's captives. Fantasy drama, starring Alfie Allen, Emilia Clarke and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau

programme.title: Game of Thrones: The Prince of Winterfell
programme.sub-title: The Prince of Winterfell Season 2, Episode 8
programme.desc: King in the North Robb Stark is incensed when he learns he has been betrayed by one of his closest friends, while his fugitive sister Arya calls in a debt, leaving mysterious convict Jaqen H'ghar with a difficult decision to make. Meanwhile, across the Narrow Sea, Daenerys is presented with a dilemma as she struggles to negotiate with the seemingly egalitarian lords of Qarth

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Blackwater
programme.desc: King Joffrey's days on the Iron Throne appear to be numbered as Stannis lays claim to his late brother Robert's realm with a naval assault on King's Landing. The realities of all-out war leave the young tyrant reeling, and it is left to his sharp-witted uncle Tyrion to launch a defensive strategy that could save his family and decide the fate of the seven battle-scarred kingdoms of Westeros. Jack Gleeson, Peter Dinklage and Stephen Dillane star in an episode written by George RR Martin, whose novels form the basis for the series

programme.title: Game of Thrones: Valar Morghulis
programme.desc: Theon Greyjoy stirs his men into action as Maester Luwin offers some final advice, Arya receives a gift from the mysterious Jaqen, and Daenerys summons the courage to enter the House of the Undying. Meanwhile, Jon proves his worth as a brother of the Night's Watch to Qhorin Halfhand. Fantasy drama, based on George RR Martin's Song of Ice and Fire novels, and starring Maisie Williams, Kit Harington and Alfie Allen

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Captain John Miller takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honour, decency and courage.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Based on the botched mission during America's military involvement in Somalia in the early 1990s. An attempt by US Army Rangers parachuted into Mogadishu to capture a warlord's two top lieutenants goes disastrously wrong when two helicopters are shot down.

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: Marvin is a Milwaukee realtor who receives a crimson envelope from a former partner-in-crime whom he left for dead. He now finds himself thrust back into a world of ruthless hit men and double-crosses that turn his open houses into deadly war zones.

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: Marvin is a Milwaukee realtor who receives a crimson envelope from a former partner-in-crime whom he left for dead. He now finds himself thrust back into a world of ruthless hit men and double-crosses that turn his open houses into deadly war zones.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

programme.title: Twisters
programme.desc: Competing teams of storm chasers find themselves in a fight for their lives as multiple systems converge over central Oklahoma.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: ‫When his mentor and close friend is murdered, an elite assassin's next assignment is self-imposed - he wants those responsible dead.‬

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.

programme.title: Superman Returns
programme.desc: The Man of Steel returns to Earth after a five-year absence to find Lex Luthor ready to take over the world, and Lois Lane shacked up with a new man and a kid. The people have lost faith in their former saviour. Can Superman save their lives and regain their trust?

programme.title: Superman Returns
programme.desc: The Man of Steel returns to Earth after a five-year absence to find Lex Luthor ready to take over the world, and Lois Lane shacked up with a new man and a kid. The people have lost faith in their former saviour. Can Superman save their lives and regain their trust?

programme.title: Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: Perseus travels the underworld to defeat the evil god Hades, who seeks to overthrow Zeus and bring hell to Earth.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody, a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco, only to be forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe. Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake as they make their way towards their final battleground back in San Francisco.

programme.title: Man of Steel
programme.desc: Though struggling with the ramifications of his extraordinary origin and abilities, young Clark Kent must become a hero and save those he loves from a dire threat. Based on DC Comics characters.

programme.title: Man of Steel
programme.desc: Though struggling with the ramifications of his extraordinary origin and abilities, young Clark Kent must become a hero and save those he loves from a dire threat. Based on DC Comics characters.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: A tormented father makes vengeance his life's mission after his son is caught in a gang's crossfire and dies on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary is assigned a target on a flight. But when rival assassins board the plane, assassin and target are forced to team up.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: The sequel to `Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: A multi-expression emoji, gets sentenced to be deleted after he messes up a message his user sent to his crush. Gene escapes the agents sent to destroy him and accepts his uniqueness.

programme.title: Rise of the Guardians
programme.desc: When evil spirit Pitch and his army of nightmares come to Earth, the Guardians must protect the children of the world while they sleep. Pitch is powerful, so they need help from a reluctant new team member: the impish spirit of winter, Jack Frost.

programme.title: Rise of the Guardians

programme.title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Father Christmas travels to Wonderland to help save Christmas after the Queen of Hearts had outlawed it.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programme.desc: Flightless birds lead a mostly happy existence, except for Red, who just can't get past the daily annoyances of life. His temperament leads him to anger management class, where he meets fellow misfits Chuck and Bomb. Red becomes even more agitated when his feathered brethren welcome green pigs to their island paradise. As the swine begin to get under his skin, Red joins forces with Chuck and Bomb to investigate the real reason behind their mysterious arrival.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends are surprised when a green pig suggests that they put aside their differences and unite to fight a common threat. Aggressive birds from an island covered in ice are planning to use an elaborate weapon to destroy the fowl and swine way of life. After picking their best and brightest, the birds and pigs come up with a scheme to infiltrate the island, deactivate the device and return to their respective paradises intact.

programme.title: The Garfield Movie
programme.desc: Garfield, the Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, finds himself on a wild outdoor adventure when his long-lost father draws him into a high-stakes heist.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: ‫Flint Lockwood now works at The Live Corp Company. When he discovers his infamous machine still operates, creating mutant food beasts, he and his friends must save their town.‬

programme.title: The Wild Robot
programme.desc: Shipwrecked on a deserted island, a robot named Roz must learn to adapt to its new surroundings. Building relationships with the native animals, Roz soon develops a parental bond with an orphaned gosling.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven year old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition.
